notes.title: Friday Night Links Begins July 2nd
notes.content:
Hey folks! 

Beginning on July 2nd we will be publishing new 9-hole Events for users to participate in every Friday. These disappear by Monday, so you'll need to complete your round by then. The Season will run until August 1st, with a cumulative point winner being crowned at the end! 

The featured courses will be the (5) that are included with the Links E6 download - so make sure to study and practice to prepare. Once you're ready, you simply click the [b]EVENTS[/b] tab in the Main Menu and find the Links E6 Events. 

We will be posting updated standings throughout the month, If you would like to follow along and check in on the leaderboard, you can find it at: portal.e6golf.com 

[b]Event Details[/b]

[list]
[*] Black Tees
[*] No Mulligans
[*] Variable Course & Wind Conditions
[*] Must Be Signed In - No Guest
[*] 2 Foot Gimmies
[*] 9-Hole Rounds
[*] 18-Hole Final 
[/list]

We want to thank all of you for joining the Links E6 community! We appreciate your time and are excited to compete head-to-head. This is #GolfConnected
